open_hypotheses.claim: Reflective (watching from outside) and reflexive (the watching collapsing into the watched) are TWO independent failure modes, not two settings on one dial. Reflective is instrumented by a non-voiced Witness that names what both poles avoided (witnessDistance); reflexive by replies collapsing onto their own reply centroid (selfSimilarity, on-device). The engine exposes both and trades neither. This is what makes Reflective a real rung vs Focused (Focused runs 0 witness turns). Deliberately NO single 'reflectiveness' knob.

open_hypotheses.claim: The dialectic/adaptation core loop generalizes to any skill-with-feedback-and-repetition; language/pedagogy is the FIRST TEST CASE, not the destination. A learning device should be a mirror that watches how THIS teacher/student fails and reshapes around that failure, not a vocabulary vending machine.

ARC rewards forming a NEW abstraction per-instance over retrieving a cached one. The axis worth flipping onto our own work: build for on-the-fly rule induction wherever we currently rely on lookup — not the leaderboard.

The synthetic-task MPC demos are a break-finding wind tunnel (fracture the protocol on purpose to find the seams) AND a trust interface for skeptics who never read a spec — design for what a non-technical observer walks away believing about capability boundaries.

For recognition, a small adversarial set targeting known failure modes (homophones, code-switching, disfluencies) beats 150 random sentences — random sampling proves what the system already handles; failures cluster around structure.
